name: Savings Goals & Sinking Funds Tracker Spreadsheet (Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers)
description:
Set a goal and a date, log what you put in, and see exactly what to save each month to get there. Works for an emergency fund, sinking funds (car insurance, holidays, gifts, repairs), a trip, a house deposit or anything else.

What's inside (one .xlsx file, 4 tabs):
• Start Here: name, currency label, how much you can set aside per month and the year, plus short instructions.
• Dashboard: total of all targets, saved so far, still to save, overall progress, total needed per month vs what you set aside (spare or short), goals done. Every goal with a progress bar, and net savings by month.
• Goals: up to 20 goals or sinking funds. Target amount, target date and starting balance. Saved, left, % done, months left, save-per-month to hit the date and status (Saving, Done, Past date) are calculated for you.
• Log: 2,000 rows. Date, goal from a dropdown, Deposit or Withdrawal, amount and a note.

Sample data shows how it works. Delete it when you start.

Works in Microsoft Excel, Apple Numbers and Google Sheets (upload the file to Google Drive and open it with Google Sheets). No macros, no add-ons, no subscription. Any currency.

Images show the file with sample data. A planning tool, not financial advice.

This product was created with the help of AI and checked before listing. It is an original product, not resold.
